investigateFailure.title: Investigate the failing scan result
investigateFailure.description: Review the latest scan output from {{provider}}. Check the Scan Run History section above for the detailed failure summary and root cause.

reviewRequirements.title: Review the test requirements
reviewRequirements.description: This test requires manual verification. Review the linked controls and evidence requirements to understand what compliance gap exists.

acknowledgeOverdue.title: Acknowledge the overdue status
acknowledgeOverdue.description: This test was due on {{date}} and is now overdue. Prioritize completing this test to avoid compliance drift.

reviewStatus.title: Review current test status
reviewStatus.description: This test is currently {{status}}. Review linked controls and evidence to ensure continued compliance.

verifyControls.title: Verify linked control implementation
verifyControls.description: Ensure the following controls are fully implemented: {{controls}}. Check each control's status and verify its implementation aligns with the test requirements.

mapControls.title: Map relevant controls
mapControls.description: No controls are linked to this test. Use the Controls section below to link the applicable ISO/SOC controls that this test validates.

collectEvidence.title: Collect and attach evidence
collectEvidence.description: No evidence is currently attached. Gather the required documentation, screenshots, or automated reports that prove compliance and attach them using the Evidence section below.

updateEvidence.title: Update evidence with remediation proof
updateEvidence.description: Current evidence ({{count}} items) may reflect the pre-remediation state. After fixing the issue, collect fresh evidence showing the resolved state and attach it.

verifyEvidence.title: Verify evidence freshness
verifyEvidence.description: {{count}} evidence item(s) attached. Ensure the latest evidence is still current and reflects the actual state of the system.

applyFix.title: Apply the fix in {{provider}}
applyFix.description: Make the necessary configuration changes directly in {{provider}}. Common fixes include updating security policies, enabling required features, or patching vulnerable components.

rerunScan.title: Re-run the automated scan
rerunScan.description: After applying the fix, trigger a new scan using the "Run Scan Now" button above. Wait for the scan to complete and verify the result changes to Pass.

confirmFrameworks.title: Confirm framework alignment
confirmFrameworks.description: This test maps to: {{frameworks}}. Verify that remediation actions satisfy the requirements of all linked frameworks.

markComplete.title: Mark the test as complete
markComplete.description: Once all controls are implemented, evidence is collected, and the compliance gap is resolved, use the "Mark Complete" button to close this test cycle.

auditReadiness.title: Document for audit readiness
auditReadiness.description: This test is linked to {{count}} audit(s). Ensure all remediation actions and evidence are thoroughly documented for the auditor.

markAsPassed.prompt: Evidence attached. Mark this test as passed?
